India Squad: Rohit Sharma, Shubman Gill(c), Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, Axar Patel, KL Rahul(w), Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar, Arshdeep Singh, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Mohammed Siraj, Ishan Kishan, Kuldeep Yadav

A dark burgundy-coloured 'Thunderstorm Warning' has popped up as soon as you look up the weather at Seddon Park. There's clearly been plenty of rain over the last 12 hours, and it's safe to assume that we won't be getting a start on time. One positive, though, is that, just like life, there's always hope, even if it's just a glimmer. The chances of rain are expected to reduce significantly (not raining right now) over the next few hours, so let's keep our fingers crossed for a shortened affair, if not a full game.

Moving on to the cricket, this will be the last outing for several players from both sides who have been named in their respective Test squads, as they switch gears and begin preparations for the longer format. Looking at the names in those squads, New Zealand arguably stand to be more affected by these departures than India. That could make things even more interesting if we do get some cricket.
